messages:
maria_garcia: Heads-up — vendor just notified a staggered delivery for PO 98432. Partial shipment only (120/480 units) arriving early April, remainder pushed to May. This impacts Dedicated capacity in us-west-2 and some marketplace SKUs. Need coordination asap. cc @simon_cheng

simon_cheng: Ugh. Which Dedicated pools are impacted specifically?

maria_garcia: us-west-2 -> d-gpu-pool-a planned 480 now 120 on-time. Marketplace reserved SKUs tied to that pool will show limited availability for new signups.

alex_platt: Can we borrow burst capacity from other regions? eu-west-1 has ~200 spare units but cross-region latency and egress costs.

jessica_ops: Vendor offered an expedite option (12% of PO) to shift the remainder to mid-April. I pinged procurement for fast-track approval. Need decision who covers cost.

simon_cheng: :thinking_face: For enterprise customers we probably need to expedite. Which active contracts will be impacted?

maria_garcia: ACME Corp has Dedicated 2x64 reserved from that pool, and FinSys has a reserved commit. Both have canary windows next week.

alex_platt: Short-term mitigation: reroute new Dedicated traffic to eu-west and enable aggressive prefix/KV caching to reduce tokens and load. Quick config snippet I'll push:

```
routing_policy:
  - prioritize: eu-west-1
  - fallback: compress_cache: true
```

I'll monitor token throughput after flip.

supply-bot: Shipment event: PO 98432 partial pickup completed. 120 units in transit. Remaining 360 units pending vendor confirmation. Tracking: https://logistics.example/track/1ZABC123

jessica_ops: If we don't expedite, propose 3-step plan: 1) Move 150 units from eu-west to us-west (inventory transfer approved by ops), 2) Offer ACME temporary burst windows / credits, 3) Pause marketplace onboarding for low-tier/new signups until capacity normalizes.

simon_cheng: I'll draft partner/marketplace comms to reflect temporary SKU limits and possible delays. maria, can you confirm partial arrival date so I can include it?

maria_garcia: Partial arrival confirmed for 2026-04-03. I'm asking vendor for written commitment on final delivery mid-May.

alex_platt: I'll roll a routing override flag to reduce cold starts: feature.marketplace.capacity_hold=true. Also enabling extra KV caching for affected pools.

jessica_ops: Procurement approved expedite for revenue-at-risk customers only. Tagging finance for PO amend.

maria_garcia: Thanks everyone. Opening a quick ops sync tomorrow 10:00am to coordinate node migrations and customer handoffs. :calendar:

simon_cheng: SG. I'll share a short customer-friendly blurb after the sync for partner channels.

(threads: short follow-ups expected in the morning)
